description.narrative: The Project aims at creating an information sharing framework for the Food and Drug Agencies in the East African Trade Network. The FDAs have harmonized processes and procedures for carrying out some of their regulatory functions. This will now be placed on digital platforms to enhance efficiency in service delivery for cross border trade in pharmaceuticals and processed foods.
